feature_normalization: Round to12decimal places in memory; serialize in original datasheet order; verify frozen canonical SHA256 before fitting.

bootstrap.unit: acquisition-prefix groups, paired; biological independence unverified

limitations: A retrospective reanalysis of previously used labelled images, not a new blinded clinical experiment.
Date-like prefixes are acquisition-group proxies, not confirmed independent chips or donors; biological independence remains unverified.

CRC expectation guarantee requires exchangeable acquisition groups and fixed independent scoring/family. It controls overall equal-group wrong release, not wrong/accepted, high-probability batch risk, or image-weighted population risk.
Paired group bootstrap intervals condition on the fitted models and calibration choice;14 test groups limit interval stability.
Selected group-level features need the complete unlabelled acquisition batch; per-image online streaming is outside this replay.
